question: A new rule, predictions pushed first: a stand-in whose rows were already below its content before a change takes the rows its content needs after it, whatever the change. Read on a phone Newsletter that hangs out (names on at the desktop, then the phone view), with the frozen refit 1 rule's cases beside it.
rule: Before a change: hung = ceil(x0 - 0.02) > rows, x0 the content in rows. After it: refit 1 as frozen (grow to ceil, shrink past a row to floor, else keep), then if hung, at least ceil(x - 0.02).
how: Probe page, window 1600 by 1000. A new Newsletter from the menu (10 columns by 8 rows), Edit, Show Name Field on; the phone view with the panel open; then Show Name Field off, on, off; Design, alignLeft, alignCenter; the desktop view. The whole run twice, the second after Exit Without Saving and Edit again. Rows are the block's grid area in the phone part of its rule (desktop part for the desk reads).
